attributes.description: Vinati Organics Ltd is an integrated B2B manufacturer of the specialty monomers, aromatics, butyl phenols, antioxidants, polymers and inorganic /specialty intermediates, with four manufacturing sites in Maharashtra and exports to global chemical customers.[1]
